business_overview.one_sentence: 公司主要生产和销售木制品，并把木制品生产废料回收加工为生物质颗粒燃料。

segments.name: Manufacturing and sales of wooden products
segments.source: 2023 Annual Report pp.8-9 and note 5 p.120

segments.name: Manufacturing and sales of renewable energy products
segments.source: 2023 Annual Report pp.8-9 and note 5 p.120

business_overview.revenue_model: 销售木制品为主，2023年木制品收入占99.2%；地区上澳大利西亚收入占72%。再生能源业务来自木制品生产废屑转化为生物质颗粒燃料。
business_notes: 2023年收入同比下降36.0%，主要因澳大利西亚市场需求显著下滑。
2023年前三大超过10%客户合计收入152,579千元，占总收入约51.3%。

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: 2023 and 2022 reported net losses; 2023 segment result excluding government subsidies was a RMB5.054m loss. 2023 positive operating cash flow was supported by depreciation and working-capital movements while bank deposit interest of RMB16.194m is tied to funds assets considered in the detachable cash pool. A positive recurring distributable cash profit denominator is not established.

gaps: Current annual fact pack has no official 2021 cash flow statement extraction; 2021 profit is from the five-year financial summary in the 2023 annual report.
Annual report does not split cash and deposits by parent company, PRC subsidiary, offshore subsidiary or immediate dividendability.
No exact minimum operating cash disclosure; operating cash retained is an analyst estimate based on 2023 cost base, working capital needs and management liquidity statement.
